label_mapping_proposal_for_main_agent.status: Proposed only; not frozen and not assigned to annotators.

definitions.positive: The frozen title explicitly conveys approval, support, satisfaction or another positive evaluation.
definitions.negative: The frozen title explicitly conveys dissatisfaction, concern, criticism, loss or another negative evaluation.
definitions.neutral: The title mainly reports an event or an attributed allegation without a clear evaluative stance.
definitions.mixed: The title clearly contains both positive and negative evaluations and cannot be reduced to one direction.
definitions.unclear: The title is too short, ambiguous or context-dependent to determine its expressed tone.

label_mapping_proposal_for_main_agent.change_from_v6_proposal: Keep the two already-defined mixed/unclear categories and remove the undefined uncertain value; do not collapse mixed or unclear into neutral.
